rules: If ICE reports that the maximum price of oil (as defined exclusively by the set of WTI front-month settle prices) is above $115 between Issuance and Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

event: Will the House vote on impeaching Pete Hegseth?
title: Will the House vote on impeaching Pete Hegseth?
rules: If the House has conducted any recorded vote on any resolution impeaching Pete Hegseth, any motion to table, refer, or postpone such a resolution, or any special rule that specifically refers to such a resolution after Issuance and before Nov 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
